<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ndots(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); pts=set()
    for r in range(9,60):
        for c2 in range(7,60):
            if a[r][c2]=='N': pts.add((r,c2))
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in seen or q not in pts: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q); r,cc=q
            for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (r+dr,cc+dc) in pts: st.append((r+dr,cc+dc))
        out.append((min(x[0] for x in comp),min(x[1] for x in comp)))
    return sorted(out)
print("start:", ndots(current_frame))

action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':13}])
print("after click (1,1):", ndots(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
